newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bank Hapoalim plans Euronote offering.
newsitem.headline: Bank Hapoalim plans Euronote offering.

text.p: Hapoalim International NV, a subsidiary of Israel's Bank Hapoalim, has signed a circular for an offering of floating rate Euronotes totalling $200 million, the bank said on Sunday.
The notes will be issued without an underwriter and will be fully guaranteed by Bank Hapaolim. They will be traded on the London Stock Exchange.

The bank said in a statement that the offering was aimed at raising long-term funds in foreign currency. The notes will mature July 2006 and carry an early-redemption option starting in July 2002, the bank said.
The first tranche will take place later this month and the bank expects to raise the first $50 million by the end of March. The remainder will be raised between March and July, Hapoalim said.
